svg.title: CS229 2018 Lecture Notes
svg.desc: Six small panels, one for each part of the course: a least-squares line through noisy points, a maximum-margin separator between two classes, a fully connected neural network, the learning curves of a model with high variance, a mixture of three Gaussians fitted by EM with each point coloured by its soft assignment, and the four-by-three grid world solved by value iteration, coloured by value with the optimal action in each cell.
svg.text: Stanford Machine Learning, written from Andrew Ng’s Autumn 2018 lectures
